claims.statement: AI FinOps requires structured collaboration between engineering, platform, product, finance, and security teams.
claims.scope: Organizational practice; establishes clear showback, chargeback, and business value alignment for AI investments.

claims.statement: Standardizing telemetry attributes via OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions prevents vendor lock-in and simplifies cross-model attribution.
claims.scope: Implementation standard using gen_ai.* attributes for request, response, token usage, and error dimensions.

claims.statement: Model billing requires exact model, tier, modality, and contract rates, rather than a generic blended token price assumption.
claims.scope: Prices vary by prompt length, cache eligibility, region, modality, and volume commitments.

claims.statement: Application token estimates must be routinely reconciled against provider billing exports to account for committed use discounts, minimums, credits, and taxes.
claims.scope: Calculated token totals are operational proxies, while invoice ledgers represent true financial liability.

claims.statement: Cost reduction strategies must be bounded by rigorous quality evaluation; a cheaper model that increases retry rates or human review increases total cost.
claims.scope: Unit economics must measure cost per successful, accepted task rather than isolated token price.

claims.statement: Prompt caching provides 50% to 90% cost reduction on recurring context, system instructions, and RAG document prefixes.
claims.scope: Applicable when prompts share identical prefix tokens above provider-mandated minimum thresholds (e.g. 1024 tokens).

claims.statement: Dynamic model routing sends routine tasks to fast lightweight models and escalates hard cases to frontier models, reducing average cost by 60-80%.
claims.scope: Requires an intelligent classifier or evaluator gateway with explicit latency and quality SLAs.

claims.statement: Provisioned Throughput (PTUs or Reserved Capacity) requires sustained baseline utilization above ~65% to achieve a lower unit cost than on-demand pay-as-you-go.
claims.scope: Under low or bursty off-peak traffic, paying for idle reserved capacity dramatically increases effective cost per token.

claims.statement: Self-hosting open-weight models on dedicated GPU clusters incurs substantial fixed costs for idle capacity, engineering staff, driver management, and redundancy.
claims.scope: Self-hosting break-even is achieved only at high steady-state request volumes with optimized serving stacks like vLLM.

claims.statement: Automated rate limits, token quotas, and recursion circuit breakers are required to protect against runaway autonomous agent loops.
claims.scope: Enforces max steps, per-session token budgets, and automated fallback when thresholds are breached.

claims.statement: Normalizing AI consumption data to the FinOps Foundation FOCUS™ schema enables unified multi-cloud attribution across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and SaaS APIs.
claims.scope: Maps provider-specific meters to standardized ProviderName, ServiceName, ChargeType, and ConsumedQuantity.

claims.statement: Reasoning models spend internal test-time compute tokens that are billed at premium output rates, requiring explicit token budgeting for complex chain-of-thought tasks.
claims.scope: Hidden reasoning tokens can expand total generated tokens by 3x to 10x relative to visible completion tokens.
